issues.body: At line 498 the harness constructs `ServerConfig { query_timeout: Some(Duration::from_secs(5)), ..ServerConfig::default() }`, so strictly it does not use `ServerConfig::default()` as-is. The adaptive_commit part of the claim is exact (it is inherited unchanged from the default at crates/sparq-server/src/http.rs:829, and the SPARQ_ADAPTIVE_COMMIT env override only applies to `ServerConfig::from_env`, not `default()`), so nothing the doc, note or STDOUT asserts is wrong. Purely a wording precision point on a PR whose whole purpose is claim precision.
issues.fix_hint: Optional: reword to "inherits ServerConfig::default()'s adaptive_commit (ON)" or "builds its ServerConfig from ServerConfig::default()" at the doc comment (line 356), the JSON note (line 300) and the comment at line 584. Not worth another round on its own.
issues.title: "This harness uses ServerConfig::default()" is shorthand - the harness overrides query_timeout via struct-update

verdict.summary:
Round 2 resolves every round-1 finding. All four sibling assertions of the retracted "~1/window-bound" claim are now corrected in the SAME file: the machine-readable results_json note (line ~299), the STDOUT TOTAL line (line 568), the reference comment (lines 582-585) that previously cross-referenced and contradicted the crud_stream doc, and the STDOUT reference line (line 588). A repo-wide grep under bench/serve/ finds only one remaining "1/group-commit-window" mention (line 355) and it is now correctly conditioned ("only when adaptive commit is disabled"), which matches the windowed branch at crates/sparq-serve/src/writer.rs:658-663 where a serial client with an empty queue blocks to the deadline.

Factual verification of the new claim: the harness builds ServerConfig { query_timeout: Some(5s), ..ServerConfig::default() } (line 498) and calls AppState::with_config; ServerConfig::default() sets adaptive_commit: true unconditionally (crates/sparq-server/src/http.rs:829 - the SPARQ_ADAPTIVE_COMMIT / --no-adaptive-commit override lives in from_env at http.rs:1052 and does NOT affect default()), and writer_config forwards it to WriterConfig (http.rs:6586). In adaptive mode the writer try_recv's and closes the batch the moment the backlog empties (writer.rs:650-655), so a serial client is engine-bound. Supporting tests exist (http.rs:10708 adaptive_commit_is_on_by_default, http.rs:10736 writer_config_carries_adaptive_commit_from_server_config, crates/sparq-serve/tests/writer.rs adaptive_commit_does_not_wait_the_window_for_a_serial_client). The round-1 ambiguity (WriterConfig::adaptive_commit defaults to false at writer.rs:202) is now removed by naming ServerConfig explicitly at every site, and the [SONNET-4.6] marker now carries the (sq-p7kk5) bead and prefixes the newly authored sentence.
